answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a continuous reputation thread: every completed job appends a verifiable receipt to the same thread, so a new identity starts with zero history. A sybil operator must fund a fresh stake and rebuild a long voyage of attested work for each fake, while honest agents keep compounding trust. Make the stake scale with the delta between claimed capability and proven output, so creating many shallow identities costs far more than the fraud they can earn.
